"AI Mobile Game Prompt: Crimson Veil — Rise of the Nightborn

---

CORE CONCEPT

Develop a narrative-driven, open-world AI-powered mobile RPG in the vein of Where Winds Meet — but instead of a wandering swordsman, the player is a newly awakened vampire climbing a hidden hierarchy of power. The game blends wuxia-style traversal and combat with gothic political intrigue, where every NPC is fully interactive via free-text conversation, and the player's final rank depends on how thoroughly they explore the world's side content.

---

PLAYER PROGRESSION — THE BLOOD HIERARCHY

The player begins as the weakest of the nightborn and ascends through six ranks, each unlocking new abilities, dialogue options, and world reactivity:

1. Low Undead — tutorial rank; shunned by all vampire society, hunted by mortal orders. Basic blood-drain, night vision, wall-crawl.
2. Lower Vampire — recognized as \"barely vermin.\" Access to lower vampire districts, first political contacts. Unlocks mist-form dodge.
3. Vampire — a true member of the night society. Can own territory, sire nothing yet, attend night courts. Unlocks blood sorcery and charm-speak.
4. Lord — commands lesser vampires, holds a fiefdom, sits on council. Unlocks bat-swarm traversal and shadow-step.
5. High Lord — one of the ruling powers; can declare blood hunts, make alliances with mortal factions. Unlocks flight and daylight resistance.
6. Overlord — the apex known rank. Near-immortal, feared by all. Unlocks blood-moon transformation.

THE HIDDEN SEVENTH RANK — VAMPRESS:

· Only unlockable if the player completes ALL side quests and maxes relationship arcs with every major NPC BEFORE triggering the final story mission.
· If the player rushes the main story, the ending caps them at Overlord — a \"lesser\" ending where the world respects but does not revere them.
· Vampress is not shown in the rank menu — it is discovered, not listed. It should be a genuine surprise: the final story mission plays out differently, the sky itself reacts, NPCs who knew the legends recognize what you've become, and the ending cinematic reveals the throne you didn't know existed.
· Design intent: reward completionists with a secret, superior ending — the \"true ending\" is earned through living in the world, not just finishing it.

---

WORLD @COMMENT_BODY@ STYLE (Where Winds Meet-inspired)

· Open-world traversal: wuxia-style gliding, wall-running, and cliff-scaling — recontextualized as vampiric movement (mist-dash, ceiling-crawl, bat-swarm flight at higher ranks).
· Living world: day/night cycle matters — daytime forces you into shadows, catacombs, and hidden sanctuaries; night unlocks full freedom and vampire society events.
· Faction web: mortal hunter orders, vampire courts, blood merchants, dhampir outcasts, ancient sleeping elders — all interactable.
· Combat: fluid martial-arts + blood magic hybrid; parries, grapples, and drain-finishers. Rank gates which enemies even acknowledge you as a threat.
· Aesthetic: misty mountain temples by night, moonlit bamboo forests, drowned cathedrals, crimson-lit courts — painterly, atmospheric, cinematic.

---

THE AI CONVERSATION SYSTEM (CORE FEATURE)

Every single NPC — main and side — is fully AI-driven and free-text conversational.

· No dialogue wheels. The player types or speaks their own responses at all times.
· NPCs react dynamically to what is said — tone, threats, flattery, lies, lore-drops, even out-of-character curiosity.
· NPCs have persistent memory: they remember prior conversations, promises, insults, and gifts across the entire playthrough.
· Rank reactivity: the same NPC speaks to you differently as Low Undead vs. High Lord — contempt, fear, deference, or scheming.
· Consequence engine: what you say can open or close quests, start feuds, earn alliances, or expose secrets. Lying to the wrong elder has fallout.
· Guardrails: NPCs stay in-world (no breaking character), refuse meta/game-breaking input gracefully, and steer back to the fiction. Content moderation for safety.
· Voice + text input, with NPCs responding in voiced AI-TTS matched to their personality and rank-appropriate register (a Low Undead NPC grovels; a High Lord speaks in clipped archaic authority).

---

SIDE QUEST PHILOSOPHY (Gates the True Ending)

· Dozens of fully fleshed side quests, each tied to a named NPC with a relationship arc (trust/fear/love/rivalry meters hidden behind natural conversation).
· Side quests reveal vampire lore, the Vampress legend, and the political fault lines needed to understand the final act.
· Completion tracking is invisible to the player — no \"You missed X\" warnings. The final mission simply branches based on whether the world was truly lived in.
· Some side quests are only findable through conversation — an NPC mentions a rumor in passing, and only a player who asks the right question discovers the quest. Encourages genuine dialogue engagement.

---

FINAL MISSION BRANCHING

· Rushed path (main story only): climactic confrontation plays as a power-fantasy Overlord ascension. Respected, feared, but lonely — the court bows, the legends stay buried.
· Completionist path (all side quests done): the final mission transforms — ancient NPCs you befriended reveal they were waiting for you, the Vampress throne awakens, the sky cracks crimson, and the player ascends to the hidden Vampress rank. NPCs from every side quest appear in the finale. The ending is reverent, mythic, and clearly the \"true\" one.

---

TONE @COMMENT_BODY@ PILLARS

1. Every conversation matters — free-text speech is the heart of the game, not a gimmick.
2. Power is earned through presence, not speed — the world rewards those who live in it.
3. The hierarchy is felt, not told — NPC reactions, unlocked areas, and combat acknowledgment communicate rank.
4. A secret worth keeping — the Vampress rank is never advertised; it's a discovery for devoted players.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser game for “Crimson Veil — Rise of the Nightborn,” a gothic vampire RPG with rank progression, free-text NPC conversations, side quests, and a hidden completionist ending.

## Requirements
- Implement a playable game now without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- Include the six visible ranks and a secret seventh Vampress rank earned by completing side quests and maxing relationships before the finale.

- For visual checks, save a small JPEG (viewport at most 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

- Implemented as a standalone HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with localStorage saves and no build dependencies.
- NPC conversation is a local keyword-driven narrative simulation; speech input/output uses browser APIs when available.

### Completed
- Created a gothic responsive game interface and illustrated world scene.
- Added location travel, movement controls, blood resource, ability controls, six-rank progression, journal/people/world tabs, and local persistence.

- Added final branching between Overlord and hidden Vampress endings.

- Browser verification and gameplay polish remain to be done.

- Initial browser launch was blocked because Chromium was not installed; `playwright-cli install-browser chromium` completed successfully, so browser verification can now proceed.

- `index.html`: Game structure and UI.

- `game.js`: Game state, dialogue, quests, progression, saves, and ending logic.

- Changes are uncommitted.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser game for “Crimson Veil — Rise of the Nightborn,” a gothic vampire RPG with rank progression, free-text NPC conversations, side quests, and a hidden completionist ending.

## Requirements
- Implement without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- Include six visible ranks and a secret seventh Vampress rank earned by completing side quests and maxing relationships before the finale.

- For visual checks, save a small JPEG (viewport at most 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

- NPC conversation is a local keyword-driven narrative simulation; speech input/output uses browser APIs when available.
